iti.id, iti.task_id, it.kb_id, it.created_by as task_created_by, iti.asset_id, iti.target_index_generation, iti.file_name, iti.file_hash, iti.stage, iti.status, iti.progress, it.dedupe_strategy, iti.dedupe_result, iti.duplicate_asset_id, iti.error_code, iti.error_message, iti.created_at, iti.updated_at, iti.finished_at
mapper.select: select from ingestion_task where created_by = #{createdBy} and client_request_id = #{clientRequestId} limit 1
select from ingestion_task order by created_at desc, id desc limit #{limit}
select from ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_task it on it.id = iti.task_id where iti.task_id = #{taskId} order by iti.created_at asc, iti.id asc

select from ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_task it on it.id = iti.task_id where it.kb_id = #{kbId} and iti.task_id = #{taskId} and iti.status = 'FAILED' and iti.asset_id is not null order by iti.created_at asc, iti.id asc
select from ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_task it on it.id = iti.task_id where iti.status = 'RUNNING' order by iti.id asc
select from ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_task it on it.id = iti.task_id where it.kb_id = #{kbId} and iti.task_id = #{taskId} and iti.id = #{itemId}

select from ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_task it on it.id = iti.task_id where it.kb_id = #{kbId} and iti.task_id = #{taskId} and iti.id = #{itemId} and iti.status = 'FAILED' and iti.asset_id is not null for update

mapper.update: update ingestion_task_item set stage = 'PARSE', status = 'RUNNING', progress = greatest(progress, 20), error_code = null, error_message = null, updated_at = current_timestamp(6), finished_at = null where id = #{itemId} and status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: select from ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_task it on it.id = iti.task_id where iti.id = #{itemId} and iti.status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.update: update ingestion_task_item iti inner join ingestion_task it on it.id = iti.task_id set iti.stage = 'UPLOAD', iti.status = 'PENDING', iti.progress = 0, iti.target_index_generation = #{nextTargetIndexGeneration}, iti.error_code = null, iti.error_message = null, iti.updated_at = #{updatedAt}, iti.finished_at = null where it.kb_id = #{kbId} and it.id = #{taskId} and iti.id = #{itemId} and iti.status = 'FAILED' and iti.asset_id is not null
mapper.select: select distinct target_index_generation from ingestion_task_item where asset_id = #{assetId} and target_index_generation is not null order by target_index_generation asc
mapper.update: update ingestion_task it join ( select task_id, count(1) as total_count, sum(case when status in ('SUCCESS', 'SKIPPED') then 1 else 0 end) as success_count, sum(case when status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end) as failure_count, sum(case when status = 'RUNNING' then 1 else 0 end) as running_count, sum(case when status = 'PENDING' then 1 else 0 end) as pending_count from ingestion_task_item where task_id = #{taskId} group by task_id ) s on it.id = s.task_id set it.total_count = s.total_count, it.success_count = s.success_count, it.failure_count = s.failure_count, it.running_count = s.running_count, it.status = case when s.running_count > 0 then 'RUNNING' when s.pending_count > 0 then 'PENDING' when s.failure_count = s.total_count then 'FAILED' when s.success_count = s.total_count then 'SUCCESS' else 'PARTIAL_SUCCESS' end, it.updated_by = #{updatedBy}, it.updated_at = #{updatedAt}, it.finished_at = case when s.running_count + s.pending_count > 0 then null else #{updatedAt} end where it.id = #{taskId} and it.kb_id = #{kbId}
